create_DPTDepthModel: create a DPTDepthModel instance for monocular depth estimation from images
create_DPTSegmentationModel: create a DPTSegmentationModel instance for semantic segmentation with a given number of classes
run_DPT_forward: run the DPT model forward pass on an input tensor to get feature outputs
build_DPT_with_backbone: build a DPT model with a specified ViT backbone like vitb16_384 or vitl16_384
review_DPTDepthModel_invert: review the DPTDepthModel forward method to understand depth inversion with scale and shift
